name: Mountaineer Thalos
summary: At Coldridge Pass, Mountaineer Thalos warns travelers of troggs in the tunnel. He guards the route from Coldridge Valley toward Kharanos and guides couriers carrying urgent reports.

sections.title: Guardian of Coldridge Pass
sections.body: At the mouth of Coldridge Pass, Mountaineer Thalos guards the route out of Coldridge Valley. Troggs have burrowed up from below and overrun the tunnel, making the crossing dangerous. Thalos warns travelers who are not ready to turn back and judges whether couriers can brave the passage toward the wider kingdom.

sections.title: A Courier's Checkpoint
sections.body: After Grelin Whitebeard reports Frostmane troll movements in the secluded valley, a courier carries the report to Grelin's brother Senir in Kharanos. Before entering the tunnel, the courier is told to speak with Mountaineer Thalos. He sends capable travelers onward through the pass to Kharanos, where regional commanders coordinate Dun Morogh's defense. The route carries vital intelligence toward Ironforge's military leaders.

faq.answer: Mountaineer Thalos is an Ironforge mountaineer at the southern opening of Coldridge Pass. He guards the boundary between Coldridge Valley and the rest of Dun Morogh.

faq.q: Why is Mountaineer Thalos warning travelers away?
faq.answer: Rockjaw troggs have overrun Coldridge Pass. Thalos warns civilians and novice fighters away, letting capable couriers and hardened fighters enter.

faq.q: Where does Mountaineer Thalos send adventurers?
aliases: where do i go after thalos
faq.answer: Thalos sends travelers through Coldridge Pass toward Kharanos, the nearest settlement on the road to Ironforge.

faq.q: What report does Thalos receive from Senir Whitebeard?
faq.answer: Thalos receives no report from Senir himself. A courier bound for Grelin Whitebeard's brother Senir in Kharanos carries Grelin's account of the Frostmane troll threat in Coldridge Valley. Thalos warns the messenger about the troggs and sends them through the tunnel.

faq.q: What faction does Mountaineer Thalos belong to?
faq.answer: Thalos belongs to the Ironforge Mountaineers, frontier rangers who patrol Dun Morogh's borders, tunnels, and mountain trails for the Alliance.

faq.q: Is Coldridge Pass impassable without speaking to Thalos?
aliases: do i need to talk to thalos
faq.answer: Anyone can enter the pass, but speaking with Thalos lets a traveler carry vital reconnaissance to Kharanos and learn the dangers ahead.

angles.text: As a young dwarf leaving your homeland's nursery, you meet Thalos as a reminder that the trogg threat presses against Ironforge's thresholds.
As a gnome traveling from Gnomeregan's refugee shelters, you find Thalos guarding the main overland route toward Kharanos and Ironforge.
As an Alliance member, you rely on Thalos to maintain communication between the valley's defensive forces and central Ironforge command.
